2353-3629-4691.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
2353-3629-4691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Cloudsteel Kirin.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-5205-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3240-6462-6495-7422.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3240-6462-6495-7422.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

443-997-2738-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5435-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

567-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-6505-6972.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Repeat.

296-3532-5078-7444.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-5078-7444.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

81-4687-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G/U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-7356.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot and Forgotten Ancient trigger.
Resolve the Forgotten Ancient trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-6633-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-2762-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7159.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Tracker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4038-5963-6274.description:
Activate Marvin using Endrider Catalyzer's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

1032-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
1032-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to it.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-2999-3399-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Impassioned Orator triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

3180-4616-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1274-4929-6805.description:
Activate Royal Herbalist by paying {2} and exiling the top card of your library, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5263-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from steps 1 and 3
Repeat.

1947-2376-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-2376-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2018-2438--73.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2018-2438--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

3125-4871-6276.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
You have max speed.
3125-4871-6276.description:
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, targeting two creature cards in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Slick Imitator dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slick Imitator ability, copying Victimize, with the copy targeting Slick Imitator and another creature card in your graveyard.
Resolve the copy of Victimize, causing you to sacrifice a creature and return Slick Imitator and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature sacrificed in step 5 dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-1753-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2638-5621.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

423-3147-3609-4011.notablePrerequisites:
Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
You are able to play a number of lands this turn equal to four minus the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
423-3147-3609-4011.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Evolution Sage trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat from step 1 until Magistrate's Scepter has four or more charge counters on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

803-3276-3496-4071.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Be'lakor's second ability triggers, causing Dread Slaver to deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Dread Slaver dies as a state-based action due to its deathtouch.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

933-1938-4200.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Icewind Stalwart from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Icewind Stalwart and Glorious Protector's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart until Glorious Protector enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 2.

262-4289-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Soliton.
262-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2638-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-2638-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Tireless Tracker trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
If you made infinite mana from tapping basic lands, you may activate the Clue tokens to get infinite card draw.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

868-1031-1170-4036.description:
Cast Desperate Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library and/or graveyard for Seething Song and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Desperate Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Desperate Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

618-914-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kiki-Jiki.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
618-914-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasures.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasures, you may instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.

724-1182-1636-5220.notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
724-1182-1636-5220.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Stonecoil Serpent from the top of your library and allowing you cast it this turn.
Repeat.

643-1099-4338.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-1099-4338.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing a creature, which is a Goblin due to Maskwood Nexus.
The creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, triggering Rotlung Reanimator, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Sling-Gang Lieutenant abilities, causing any number of target player(s) to lose infinite life and you to gain infinite life.

1387-2528-3263-3368.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {4}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

1769-2151-2201-2641.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2151-2201-2641.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vindictive Lich and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vindictive Lich trigger, causing target opponent to lose five life.
Repeat from step 4.

215-527-1627-1909.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala and Llanowar Elves do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-1627-1909.description:
Activate Llanowar Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Llanowar Elves to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Symbiote to your hand.
Cast Llanowar Elves by paying {G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat from step 2.

802-914-2649-2959.manaNeeded: {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, plus commander tax if applicable, plus one additional red, white, or blue mana if opponents control exactly three artifacts and/or enchantments
802-914-2649-2959.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
802-914-2649-2959.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Heat Shimmer from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Dockside Extortionist and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Dockside Extortionist mutated creature.
The token Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Heat Shimmer from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Resolve a second trigger from step 8, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 8, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 8 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 7, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature token.
